**What happened**
A clear description of what the bot did (or stopped doing), and what you expected instead.

**Log file (please attach)**
The bot writes a log per career to:
`/storage/emulated/0/Android/data/com.lhceist41.uma_auto_plus/files/logs/<Trainee>_<timestamp>.txt`
Pull the most recent one (`adb pull "..." .`) and attach it. This is by far the most useful thing for diagnosing a stop — please include it.

**Setup**
- Device / emulator: <!-- e.g. MuMu Player 12, Samsung SM-G7810 -->
- Resolution / DPI: <!-- e.g. 1080x1920 @ 240 -->
- App version: <!-- the release you installed -->
- Scenario: <!-- URA Finale / Unity Cup / Trackblazer -->
- Character preset: <!-- which one, or "none" -->

**Screenshots**
If the bot stopped on a screen, a screenshot of that screen helps.
